English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us Had the Burj Khalifa building decorated with the Sri Lankan flag with the victory of the Sri Lankan cricket team against Bangladesh? Misleading A photo with the caption “Burj Khalifa building in Dubai lights up with Sri Lanka’s victory over Bangladesh” is circulating on social media. by Anonymous | October 25, 2021 Source – https://www.facebook.com/100012519665665/posts/1245129945914316/ Our technical inspection to discover the truth of the photo revealed that this is was a photo published in April 2019. Source- https://www.rediff.com/news/report/pix-sri-lanka-revises-easter-blasts-toll-to-253/20190426.htm Source- https://www.dailynews.lk/2019/04/26/world/183931/dubai%E2%80%99s-burj-khalifa-lights-sri-lanka-flag The colours of the Sri Lankan flag were lit up at the Burj Khalifa Building in Dubai on 26th April, 2019 in remembrance of the victims of the Easter Sunday attack in 2019 in Sri Lanka. Reports of that incident The Indian Express – https://indianexpress.com/article/trending/trending-globally/worlds-tallest-building-lights-up-in-sri-lankan-flag-colours-solidarity-urging-for-tolerance-5695841/ EMIRATES247 – https://www.emirates247.com/news/emirates/dubai-s-burj-khalifa-lights-up-sri-lanka-national-flag-2019-04-26-1.683117 Khaleej Times – https://www.khaleejtimes.com/nation/dubai/dubais-burj-khalifa-lights-up-with-sri-lanka-flag-12 On 1st January 2021, the Sri Lankan flag was hoisted at the Burj Khalifa building with the words “Happy New Year! 2021” . Source – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zBqXoqYB0sE No foreign media has reported that the Burj Khalifa Tower has been illuminated with the Sri Lankan flag over the victory of the cricket team against a match with Bangladesh in the T20 Cricket World Cup. Therefore, it is confirmed that the photograph in circulation is from former instances when the Burj Khalifa was lit with the colours of the Sri Lankan flag.
